options.name: banner_text
options.description: Specifies the text to present in the advisory banner.

options.name: console_timeout
options.description: Specifies the number of seconds of inactivity before the system logs off a user that is logged on.

options.name: gui_audit
options.description: C(true) or C(false), specifies whether or not system GUI log audit messages.

options.name: gui_setup
options.description: C(true) or C(false), the Setup utility in the browser-based Configuration utility.

options.name: lcd_display
options.description: When C(true), specifies the system menu displays on the LCD screen on the front of the unit. This setting has no effect when used on the VE platform.

options.name: mgmt_dhcp
options.description: Specifies whether or not to enable DHCP client on the management interface.

options.name: net_reboot
options.description: When C(true), specifies the next time you reboot the system, the system boots to an ISO image on the network, rather than an internal media drive.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: quiet_boot
options.description: When C(true), specifies the system suppresses informational text on the console during the boot cycle. When C(no), the system presents messages and informational text on the console during the boot cycle.

options.name: security_banner
options.description: Specifies whether the system displays an advisory message on the login screen.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the variable on the system. When C(present), guarantees an existing variable is set to C(value).
